title: Brand name with a doubled letter regresses to the dictionary word it was built from
why_real: Groww is a real fintech brand spelled as a dictionary word with a letter doubled; ASR and the formatter both happily produce the ordinary word 'grow', and only a taught personal memory can recover the brand.

expected.memory_aware: I moved my SIP to Groww.
expected.reason: The dictionary entry's forms list contains 'grow', so both retrievers find it and rewrite the dictionary word to the brand.
